assumptions.statement: Official site and key-area polygons, detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage controls, fire safety and engineering constraints are not present in the cleared package.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-sensitive spatial moves remain conceptual and must be replaced or recalculated after official and cleared professional data is supplied.

assumptions.statement: The eight building footprints are participant-generated concept components, not surveyed existing buildings or confirmed projects.
assumptions.impact: They communicate functional relationships only and cannot support demolition, retention, height, floor-area or investment conclusions.

assumptions.statement: The five mobility links are conceptual walking and cycling relationships, not road redlines, bridge/tunnel alignments or approved engineering routes.
assumptions.impact: Feasibility depends on official road, rail, ownership, utility, accessibility and safety information.

assumptions.statement: Green and public-space polygons express the proposal's design-space preference and do not represent approved green controls, river blue lines or heritage boundaries.
assumptions.impact: Green_ratio and public_space_ratio are reproducible proposal metrics but not statutory controls.

assumptions.statement: All twelve AI scenarios are concept proposals requiring a named operator, public or authorized data, human review, safety controls and an exit mechanism.
assumptions.impact: No scenario is described as approved, procured or ready for unrestricted deployment.

assumptions.statement: The four-season event and community operation system is a reference scheme rather than a confirmed government program, funding commitment or schedule.
assumptions.impact: Frequency, organizer, budget, permits and performance indicators require separate decisions.
